Path: the road — publish/install: an artifact deploys with its app's branding | 缺项 | P2

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:cli` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. Direction: a boot warning when a loaded app's branding names a runtime asset the server cannot serve

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T13:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (the runtime assets dir, `:3716`–`:3720`, whose comment says it "Silently skips if no assets directory exists") and `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts:615` (`if (!fs.existsSync(assetsDir)) return;`) ⇒ `domain:cli`; rationale: the CLI's `start`/`serve` path.

- **Why p2:** a broken logo and favicon on every signed-in page, with nothing said on either side. It was measured on 17.7.0 (hotcrm, an artifact boot outside the project directory).
- **Direction (ruled here):**
  - At boot, when a loaded app's `branding.logo` or `favicon` names `/runtime/assets/<file>` and that file is not servable, print one warning. It names the app, the file, the directory searched and `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR`.
  - When the assets directory is absent, say so in that same line, not silently.
- **⛔ Not taken here:** carrying the branding files in the artifact. That changes the deployable unit's shape, and only the CLI path is measured. It becomes a card of its own if a measured deployment (cloud, Docker) shows the loss.
- **Pins:**
  - an artifact boot from a directory without `assets/` prints the warning once, naming the file;
  - the same boot with `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR` set, or `assets/` present, prints nothing and serves the file (control).
- `Clause-②: no`: an operator log line only. Patch changeset.

- `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`: `createRuntimeAssetsPlugin` (from `:603`; the `if (!fs.existsSync(assetsDir)) return;` at `:615`).
- Pins beside them in `packages/cli`: an artifact boot from a directory without `assets/` prints the warning once, naming the app, the file, the directory searched and `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR`. The control: the same boot with `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR` set, or `assets/` present, prints nothing and serves the file.
- `.changeset/*.md`: `@objectstack/cli` `patch`.
- ⛔ Not taken: carrying branding files in the artifact (triage). ⛔ No `packages/spec` path. ⛔ No route added or removed, and no change to what `/runtime/assets/*` serves. ⛔ Not `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` `:1104`–`:1140` (declared by `domain:spec` seat 2 for #13458, `6038311314`). (Stop on breach and explain in the report.)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. `dispatch-gates --tier` over the path gives no path-derived mandate.
Clause-②: no
- An operator log line only (triage `6038494234`): no accept set, answer or public signature moves.
Responsibility: `platform code: @objectstack/cli resolves the runtime assets directory from the cwd and skips the mount without a word (serve.ts:3714–3723, utils/console.ts:615)` | `none: no boot line or check names a branding asset the server cannot serve` | `an operator who boots an artifact outside the app project directory; hotcrm reached it on 17.7.0 (the card body measures it), and every app whose branding names /runtime/assets/* can`

Those are different regions of paths outside `SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS` (only `.objectui-sha`), so this is ordinary concurrency and the later lander resolves.
